notes.title: Upgrading to version 0.0.2
notes.notes:
Completely updated physics of the characters. Players not often lose consciousness. To bring the enemy out of balance you need to hit him in the face or in the area of the belly several times. Now you can take all of the items, including the players themselves. Some of the actions on the buttons has changed (see screenshot below).

notes.title: Bug fixes
notes.notes: Kick is now the X button (on the joystick of the Xbox One was sticking). Fixed the bug with counting heads in the mode of football. The ball, after entering the gates will spawn in the center of the field.
